description:
Checks that HORIZON_API_KEY and HORIZON_BASE_URL reach the horizOn API by fetching the app's remote configs; takes no input.
Use when: first during setup, and whenever other tools fail, to tell a configuration problem from a problem of the call itself.
Not for: checking a player's session (use horizon_check_auth) or reading config values for the game (use horizon_get_all_remote_configs).
Side effects: None (read only).
Returns: {success: true, data} where data holds the app's remote configs; success means key and URL work.
Errors: A network error means HORIZON_BASE_URL is wrong or unreachable: check the URL (default https://horizon.pm). Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).
name: horizon_test_connection

anyOf.description: The app's remote configs as returned by the API
true when the API key and base URL work

title: Test Connection
